terra.problem: The passage does not say Manaen grew up in a palace or was sitting in a church.
The claim that Philip appears elsewhere in Acts needs a reference.
It assumes the baker picked Philip because the name was already in their head.
The passage lists Simeon and Lucius among the prophets and teachers, but does not say what positions they keep afterward.
Manaen's supposed palace stories add a setting the passage does not give.
The explanation repeats the sendoff and concludes with a procedural observation. It sounds generic rather than like Papa Dorin.
The snack joke mentions food other than cookies.
The joke that islands all look alike from a boat has no clear connection to the choice and does not pass the joke logic test.
The islands are in the Mediterranean Sea, not an ocean.
It says the baker chose the “wrong island,” which Papa Dorin does not say about an answer.
“Nobody got shown the dock” adds an outcome the passage does not state.
The passage says Elymas tried to turn the proconsul from the faith, not that he tried to pull him away from hearing the word.
The running comparison makes Elymas's blindness the basis of the joke and assumes he could not get far.
